raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Same loss pattern as #41909 / #41914 / #41962 / #41963: `MinimaxM2Detector`,
`MinimaxM3Detector` and `JsonArrayParser` hold text back in their buffer while
waiting for the closing marker, and `BaseFormatDetector.finish()` returns an
empty result by default. When the stream ends with an incomplete tool call still
buffered, the held-back text is silently dropped.

## Changes

Add a `finish()` override to each parser:

- `MinimaxM2Detector` flushes the buffered partial parameter block. A pure
  trailing closing tag (`</minimax:tool_call>`) is syntax residue, not user
  text, and is not re-emitted.
- `MinimaxM3Detector` flushes a partially streamed parameter value.
- `JsonArrayParser` flushes a partial JSON array; a fully closed array that
  was already parsed into calls is not re-emitted.

Normal streams are unaffected: `finish()` stays a no-op when the buffer is
empty or holds only a complete closing marker.

## Tests

Offline unit tests (no server, no model loading) for each parser cover:
- partial tool call at stream end: `finish()` releases the buffered text;
- clean stream: `finish()` returns an empty result;
- fully parsed stream: no duplication at `finish()`.

All pass locally (`pytest test/registered/unit/function_call/test_{minimax_m2_detector,minimax_m3_detector,json_array_parser}_finish.py`), ruff clean.

Hi @cyb70289, this PR is ready for review — code and unit tests are complete and pass locally. CI is blocked only by the missing run-ci label per the sglang contribution guide. If you have CI permission, could you /tag-run-ci-label when you get a chance? Happy to rebase if needed.

**CI triage of the 10-03 re-run** (head `f5711143`)

The CUDA PR Test is green; everything left red is infra-side or the opt-in extra workflow:

- `pr-test-extra-finish` / extra `call-gate`: `Missing required label 'run-ci-extra'` — the extra workflow's gate (opt-in, e.g. via `/tag-and-rerun-ci extra`). Not a code failure.

Please contact your self hosted runner administrator.` — died before any Python code ran.
- AMD `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (8)`: `test_tracing.py` exit 1; the same job passed on the 10-01 run with the identical branch head, and the change only touches function-call detectors. Reads as flake / main drift.
- CPU `build-test (xeon-spr ...)`: `Error response from daemon: No such container: ci_sglang_spr2` — runner-side.

@cyb70289 (thanks again for the `run-ci` label) — since three of these are runner/infra-side, could you re-run the failed jobs when convenient? And if the extra suite is needed here, it needs the `run-ci-extra` opt-in; if not, that finisher is red by design and can be left alone.

All workflows gated on `run-ci` pass their gate now — the gate log shows `PR Labels: [run-ci]`, and e.g. the `PR Test (AMD)` gate is green. The only red gates left are the two **extra** workflows (`PR Test Extra`, `PR Test Extra (AMD)`): `Missing required label 'run-ci-extra'` (an opt-in label). If the extra suite isn't needed for this PR, those can stay red as-is.

The remaining red jobs are all runner/infra-side; the patch itself only touches `python/sglang/srt/function_call/` (3 files, +31 lines) plus 3 unit tests:

- **NPU** (`base-b-test-*-npu-a3`, `multimodal-gen-test-*-npu-a3`): `HTTP error 403` fetching `triton_ascend-3.2.2` from the Huawei mirror, and `Executing the custom container implementation failed` — dies before any Python code runs.
- **CPU** `build-test (xeon-spr)`: `Error response from daemon: No such container: ci_sglang_spr2` — runner-side.
- **AMD** (`...small-amd (…, 8)`, `...small-amd-mi35x`, `...mi35x-disaggregation-amd`): exit 255; the mi300 one ends in `test/registered/observability/test_tracing.py`, an observability test unrelated to `function_call/`.

Triggering a re-run of the failed jobs; if these failures are known on main as well, no action is needed here.

Quick note on the NPU failures on the latest head (f5711143): the root cause is infra, not this PR's code.

`Install dependencies` fails because the `triton-ascend==3.2.2` wheel download from `https://sglang-ascend.obs.cn-east-3.myhuaweicloud.com/...` returns **HTTP 403 Forbidden**, and one `base-b` job also hit "The HTTP request timed out" resolving an action download. Every other platform on this head is green (Arm64, MLX, PPU, sgl-router, MUSA, XPU, plus Lint and Auto Label).

So the code change itself is clean; the NPU/AMD/Extra failures here look like the shared sglang CI infra issue (OBS 403 / runner network timeouts), likely affecting all PRs until the artifact store is fixed. Happy to re-run once the wheel URL is reachable again.

+"""Unit tests for JsonArrayParser finish() flush - no server, no model loading."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.json_array_parser import JsonArrayParser
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+TOOL = Tool(
+    type="function",
+    function={
+        "name": "get_weather",
+        "description": "x",
+        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}},
+    },
+)
+
+
+class TestJsonArrayParserFinishFlush(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.d = JsonArrayParser()
+
+    def test_partial_tool_call_at_end_is_flushed(self):
+        feed = '[{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "P'
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment(feed, tools=[TOOL])
+        self.assertNotEqual(self.d._buffer, "")
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertNotEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+
+    def test_clean_stream_finish_is_noop(self):
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment("just some text", tools=[TOOL])
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+        self.assertEqual(len(r.calls), 0)
+
+    def test_complete_call_not_duplicated_at_finish(self):
+        full = '[{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Paris"}}]'
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment(full, tools=[TOOL])
+        # The base parser keeps the closed JSON in _buffer until the stream
+        # ends; finish() must not re-emit it as user text.
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+        self.assertEqual(self.d._buffer, "")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Unit tests for MinimaxM2Detector finish() flush - no server, no model loading."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.minimax_m2 import MinimaxM2Detector
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+LT = chr(60)  # <
+GT = chr(62)  # >
+
+TOOL = Tool(
+    type="function",
+    function={
+        "name": "get_weather",
+        "description": "x",
+        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}},
+    },
+)
+
+
+class TestMinimaxM2DetectorFinishFlush(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.d = MinimaxM2Detector()
+
+    def test_partial_tool_call_at_end_is_flushed(self):
+        feed = (
+            "hi "
+            + self.d.tool_call_start_token
+            + self.d.tool_call_prefix
+            + 'get_weather"'
+            + GT
+            + LT
+            + 'parameter name="city"'
+            + GT
+            + "P"
+        )
+        r1 = self.d.parse_streaming_increment(feed, tools=[TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r1.normal_text, "hi ")
+        self.assertNotEqual(self.d._buf, "")
+        r2 = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertNotEqual(r2.normal_text, "")
+
+    def test_clean_stream_finish_is_noop(self):
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment("just some text", tools=[TOOL])
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+        self.assertEqual(len(r.calls), 0)
+
+    def test_complete_call_not_duplicated_at_finish(self):
+        full = (
+            self.d.tool_call_start_token
+            + self.d.tool_call_prefix
+            + 'get_weather"'
+            + GT
+            + LT
+            + 'parameter name="city"'
+            + GT
+            + "Paris"
+            + LT
+            + "/parameter"
+            + GT
+            + LT
+            + "/invoke"
+            + GT
+            + self.d.tool_call_end_token
+        )
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment(full, tools=[TOOL])
+        # The M2 state machine consumes the trailing closing tag on the next
+        # parse; if the stream ends first, finish() must not release it as text.
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+        self.assertEqual(self.d._buf, "")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+        self.assertEqual(r1.normal_text, "hi ")

+        self.assertNotEqual(r2.normal_text, "")
+
+    def test_clean_stream_finish_is_noop(self):
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment("just some text", tools=[TOOL])
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+        self.assertEqual(len(r.calls), 0)
+
+    def test_complete_call_not_duplicated_at_finish(self):
+        full = (
+            self.d.TOOL_CALL_START
+            + self.d.INVOKE_PREFIX
+            + 'get_weather"'
+            + GT
+            + LT
+            + 'parameter name="city"'
+            + GT
+            + "Paris"
+            + LT
+            + "/parameter"
+            + GT
+            + LT
+            + "/invoke"
+            + GT
+            + self.d.TOOL_CALL_END
+        )
+        self.d.parse_streaming_increment(full, tools=[TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(self.d._buffer, "")
+        r = self.d.finish([TOOL])
+        self.assertEqual(r.normal_text, "")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
